in_marathi.name: Sikandra
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Victory over Enemies
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sikandra हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। A name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Shikhandi', the name of a legendary warrior in Hindu mythology. Shikhandi was a man born as a woman due to a curse, and he was known for his strength, bravery, and ability to defeat his enemies.
